name: AI Invoice Collections Automation - Execution Error Handler

parameters.content:
## Error process 1 — Capture and sanitize
Receives failed-execution metadata through n8n's Error Trigger. Email addresses, bearer tokens, and API-key-like values are redacted before an alert payload is built.

## Error process 2 — Classify
Assigns an operational severity and retry hint using deterministic rules. The LLM is never used to decide incident priority.

## Error process 3 — Prepare alert
Creates a minimal alert containing incident ID, workflow, last node, severity, and retry guidance. Public mode does not call Slack, Teams, PagerDuty, or email.

## Error process 4 — Audit result
Returns a structured incident object for inspection. A production workflow would persist it centrally and route the alert through an approved operational channel.
